findingDetails.title: Nine older changelog entries in the sweep-touched system-deep-loop/runtime unit lack a version key
findingDetails.scopeProof: Scripted scan of all 761 tracked changelog files: exactly 9 missing keys inside phase-2 sweep units (all in system-deep-loop/runtime), 0 missing in the other 26 sweep units; the other 178 missing files live in units phase 2 did not touch and are outside the phase 5 scope.
findingDetails.case: A reader trusts the phase 5 handoff sentence or the commit message that every older entry in a swept unit is keyed, but system-deep-loop/runtime/changelog/v1.0.0.0.md still has no version key.
findingDetails.recommendation: Key the 9 runtime entries with add_changelog_version_keys.py, or amend the handoff sentence and commit wording to scope keying to package-validated units.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Phase 5 documentation identifying system-deep-loop/runtime as outside the 28 package units collapses this to wording-only; it remains P2.
